Bazı ulusal haritalar nominal yerine ışı.en: Some national charts give the luminous or geographic range instead of the nominal range; check the chart's notes to see which one is given.

Bağımsız bilgiyle doğrula: başka bir fen.en: Confirm with independent information: cross-check with another light, a radar range or the shape of the coast; do not accept a firm position from a single light observation.

Beyaz; Iso, Oc, LFl 10s veya Mo(A).en: White; Iso, Oc, LFl 10s or Mo(A)

Bir ışığı en fazla, coğrafi menzil ile ı.en: At most, you can expect to see a light at the smaller of its geographic range and its luminous range.

Bir ışığı ne kadar uzaktan görebileceğin.en: When you judge how far away a light can be seen, keep three different kinds of range apart.

Bir ışığın görünmesinde iki sınır (parla.en: A light's visibility has two limits, brightness and the horizon. Which one applies?

Bright blocks show the light on, dark bl.en: Bright blocks show the light on, dark blocks the eclipses. The bracket above a track marks one period. Timings inside a period are illustrative; take the real characteristic from the chart and the List of Lights.

Bu dersteki tanımlar aşağıdaki yayınlara.en: The definitions in this lesson are based on the following publications.

Bu yazım IHO INT 1 (Chart 1) P bölümü ve.en: This notation follows section P of IHO INT 1 (Chart 1) and the Admiralty List of Lights and Fog Signals.

Bu yöntem GNSS olmadan da hattın üzerind.en: This method lets you check by eye that you are on the line even without GNSS, but it does not replace checks of depth, traffic and other safety factors.

COLREG Kural 21: borda fenerlerinin renk.en: COLREG Rule 21: colors and arcs of the sidelights

Coğrafi menzil yaklaşık 19,45 deniz mili.en: The geographic range is about 19.45 nautical miles. With a nominal range of 12 nautical miles, you cannot assume you will see the light from 19 miles even on a clear night; find that night's luminous range from the diagram in the List of Lights and use the smaller of the two ranges.

Coğrafi menzil, ışığın ve gözün ufuk mes.en: The geographic range is the sum of the horizon distances of the light and of the eye. With standard atmospheric refraction the approximate relation is D = 2.08 × (√H + √h), where D is in nautical miles and H, the elevation of the light, and h, the height of eye, are in meters. Try your own values in the calculator.

Deniz fenerleri (lighthouses) ve diğer ı.en: Lighthouses and other lighted aids to navigation let you recognize the coast, harbor entrances, dangers and safe passages at night. The most important fact for a navigating officer is this: every light has its own characteristic, and you find out which light you are looking at by comparing that characteristic with the chart. If you see three lights at the same time, one flashing white every 5 seconds, one flashing red twice every 10 seconds and one showing a steady green, their color, rhythm and period tell them apart.

Dönüşümlü mavi ve sarı: 1 s mavi, 0,5 s.en: Alternating blue and yellow: 1 s blue, 0.5 s dark, 1 s yellow, 0.5 s dark

Dünyanın eğriliği, ışığın yüksekliği ve.en: The geometric range set by the curvature of the Earth, the elevation of the light and the observer's height of eye.

En çok karıştırılan kavram periyottur. 1.en: The period is the most often misread element. 10s does not mean that each flash lasts 10 seconds or that there are 10 seconds between flashes: the three flashes and the eclipses between and after them take 10 seconds together, and then the sequence repeats exactly. To time the period, measure from the first flash of one group to the first flash of the next.

Enter the elevation of the light (0–1000.en: Enter the elevation of the light (0–1000 m) and the height of eye (0–100 m).

Eşit sayıda mavi ve sarı düşey şerit; te.en: Equal numbers of blue and yellow vertical stripes; an upright yellow cross as topmark

F, Fl, LFl, Oc, Iso, Q, VQ, Mo.en: F, Fl, LFl, Oc, Iso, Q, VQ, Mo

Fenerlerle çalışırken sık yapılan hatala.en: These are the common mistakes when working with lights.

First sighting can be expected at about.en: First sighting can be expected at about

Fl(3) W 10s 18m 15M şu anlama gelir: bey.en: Fl(3) W 10s 18m 15M means: a white light gives three flashes in every 10-second period; the light is 18 meters above the chart's height datum (usually MHWS on Admiralty charts) and its nominal range is 15 nautical miles.

Gece vardiyasında gördüğün ışığı tanıman.en: Rhythm is the key to recognizing a light on a night watch. In the diagrams below, bright blocks show when the light is on and dark blocks when it is off; use the play button to watch each light at its real speed. Durations inside a period are illustrative.

Gece vardiyasında ufukta bir ışık görüyo.en: On a night watch you see a light on the horizon. The ENC shows two candidate lights nearby: A, Fl W 5s, and B, Fl(2) W 10s. Both are white, so color alone is not enough.

Gemi hattın dışına çıktığında uzaktaki a.en: When the ship moves off the line, the distant rear light shifts less than the nearer front light. So, looking towards the lights, if the rear light appears to the left of the front light, the ship is to port of the line and alters course to starboard to regain it; if it appears to the right, the ship is to starboard of the line and alters course to port.

Group flashing: three flashes in each pe.en: Group flashing: three flashes in each period

Gördüğün ışık A mı, B mi?.en: Is the light you see A or B?

Görebileceğin en uzak mesafe, coğrafi me.en: The farthest you can expect to see a light is the smaller of the geographic range and that night's luminous range.

Görünmeyen fener arızalı olmayabilir: ış.en: A light you cannot see is not necessarily out of order: it may be below the geographic horizon, in another sector or behind rain or fog, or lights ashore may mask it.

Gözün ufuk mesafesi: 2,08 × √15 = 8,06 d.en: Horizon distance of the eye: 2.08 × √15 = 8.06 nautical miles

Haritada ve fener listesinde bir ışık, s.en: On the chart and in the List of Lights, a light is written as abbreviations in a fixed order: character and group, color, period, elevation and range. The entry below is representative and does not belong to a real light.

Haritadaki fener kaydı nasıl okunur?.en: How to read a light on the chart

Hat gösterme: İki ışığın aynı doğrultuya.en: Showing a track: bringing two lights into line (leading lights) or following a sector light keeps the ship on a given track.

Hattın hangi bölümünün kullanılacağı har.en: The chart shows which part of the line is to be used; outside that part the line does not guarantee safe water.

Height of the light above the chart's he.en: Height of the light above the chart's height datum, usually MHWS

Her periyotta iki örtme bir grup oluştur.en: Two eclipses form a group in each period.

Her periyotta kaç çakar veya kaç örtme o.en: How many flashes or eclipses each period contains

Her periyotta ışıklı süre karanlıktan kı.en: In each period the light is on for less time than it is off; all flashes are of equal length.

Hızlı çakar dizisi düzenli aralıklarla u.en: A sequence of quick flashes is interrupted at regular intervals by a long eclipse.

Hızlı çakar ışıklarda çakar sayısı dakik.en: For quick lights the number of flashes is defined per minute. This classification is given in IHO INT 1.

IALA Bölge A'da ışıklı işaretler.en: Lighted marks in IALA Region A

IALA R1001, The IALA Maritime Buoyage Sy.en: IALA R1001, The IALA Maritime Buoyage System

IHO INT 1 (Admiralty Chart 5011), bölüm.en: IHO INT 1 (Admiralty Chart 5011), section P: Lights

Işık bir mors harfini verir; A harfi bir.en: The light shows a Morse letter; A is one short and one long appearance of light.

Işık dizisinin bütününün kaç saniyede bi.en: How many seconds the whole sequence takes before it repeats

Işık karakteristiği (light characteristi.en: A light characteristic is the signature that describes how a light comes on, goes off or changes color over time. It has four elements; the elevation and the range of the light complete the description.

Işık karakteristiği tehlikenin kendisi d.en: A characteristic is not the danger itself: seeing Fl(2) does not prove that the light is an isolated danger mark, because another aid to navigation may use the same rhythm. Check the symbol and the position on the chart.

Işık periyodu ve doğrulama mantığı.en: Light period and how to check it

Işık renk değiştirerek yanar; ör. Al Fl.en: The light changes color; for example, Al Fl WR flashes white and red alternately.

Işık ritmi feneri teşhis etmeye, renk ve.en: The rhythm identifies the light, the color and the type of mark tell you what it means, and the chart and the bearing put the light you see in the right place.

Işık ufukta ilk belirdiğinde (rising) ve.en: When a light first rises above the horizon or dips below it, its distance from the ship is about the geographic range; together with the bearing of the light this gives a position.

Işık şiddeti ve o anki meteorolojik görü.en: The range set by the intensity of the light and the meteorological visibility at the time; it is read from the luminous range diagram in the List of Lights.

Işıklı süre karanlıktan uzundur; ışık kı.en: The light is on for longer than it is off; it is eclipsed briefly at regular intervals.

Işıklı ve karanlık süreler eşittir..en: Light and darkness are of equal duration.

Işığın sabit mi yandığı, çakar mı yoksa.en: Whether the light is fixed, flashing, occulting and so on

Işığın ufuk mesafesi: 2,08 × √30 = 11,39.en: Horizon distance of the light: 2.08 × √30 = 11.39 nautical miles

Işığın yüksekliği 30 m, köprüüstünde göz.en: The elevation of the light is 30 m, the height of eye on the bridge is 15 m and the nominal range of the light is 12 nautical miles.

Işığın yüksekliği kulenin yüksekliği değ.en: The elevation of a light is not the height of its tower: the charted value is the height of the light source above the height datum, not the height of the structure from base to top.

Kardinal işaretler bir tehlikenin hangi.en: Cardinal marks show on which side of a danger it is safe to pass: pass north of a north cardinal, east of an east cardinal, south of a south cardinal and west of a west cardinal. When lit, every cardinal light is white.

Kardinal işaretler ve emniyetli su yönü.en: Cardinal marks and the direction of safe water
Kardinal işaretler ve emniyetli su yönü.fi: Cardinal marks and the direction of safe water
Kardinal işaretler ve emniyetli su yönü.ja: Cardinal marks and the direction of safe water
Kardinal işaretler ve emniyetli su yönü.ko: Cardinal marks and the direction of safe water
Kardinal işaretler ve emniyetli su yönü.pt: Cardinal marks and the direction of safe water

Kardinal çakar sayıları saat kadranını i.en: Cardinal flash counts follow a clock face: 3 east, 6 plus a long flash south, 9 west, continuous north.

Kerterizi haritayla karşılaştır: pusula.en: Compare the bearing with the chart: convert the compass bearing to a true bearing with the corrections, then check each candidate's position, range, sectors and characteristic.

Kesintisiz ve sabit şiddette yanar..en: Shows continuously with a steady intensity.

Köprüüstünde fener teşhisi.en: Identifying a light from the bridge

Kırmızı, ortasında geniş yeşil bant.en: Red with one broad green band

Kırmızı-beyaz düşey şeritler; tepede tek.en: Red and white vertical stripes; a single red sphere as topmark

Kırmızı; Fl(2+1) dışında herhangi bir ri.en: Red; any rhythm other than Fl(2+1)

Kıyı ve mevki tanıma (landfall): Uzun bi.en: Landfall and position: sighting a particular light after a long ocean passage confirms where the ship is, and a bearing of the light is a position line.

Kıyıdaki büyük fenerler ile şamandıralar.en: Major lights on the coast and the lights on buoys and beacons use the same language; on the bridge they do four different jobs.

Kıyıdaki büyük fenerlerin karakteristiği.en: The characteristic of a major coastal light mostly tells you which light you are looking at. The lights of buoys and beacons also tell you the safe side to pass or where a danger lies. Türkiye is in IALA Region A.

Lateral işaretler ve haritadaki gösterim.en: Lateral marks and how the chart shows them

Lateral renk kuralını gemi borda fenerle.en: Do not confuse the lateral color rule with a ship's sidelights: under COLREG a ship's port sidelight is red and its starboard sidelight green, whereas the meaning of IALA lateral marks depends on the conventional direction of buoyage; in Region A, entering harbor from seaward, red marks are kept to port.

Leading lights, aynı hat üzerinde buluna.en: Leading lights are two lights on the same line. The front light is lower and nearer the ship, the rear light higher and farther away. When the two lights are vertically in line, the ship is on the leading line drawn on the chart.

Liman ve kanal girişi: Işıklar kanal sın.en: Harbor and channel entrances: lights mark the limits of channels, the heads of breakwaters and the approach channels.

Looking towards the lights: the front li.en: Looking towards the lights: the front light is lower and nearer, the rear light higher and farther. The dashed line marks the direction of the leading line.

Luminous range from the List of Lights (.en: Luminous range from the List of Lights (NM, optional)

Meteorolojik görüşün 10 deniz mili olduğ.en: The range set by the intensity of the light alone, in standard conditions with a meteorological visibility of 10 nautical miles. This is the range given in Admiralty publications.

Parlaklığa bağlı ışıklı menzil ile ufka.en: The smaller of the luminous range, set by brightness, and the geographic range, set by the horizon (D = 2.08 × (√H + √h)), decides.

Periyodu saniyeleri sayarak veya bir san.en: Time the period by counting seconds or with a stopwatch: measure from the first flash of one group to the first flash of the next, over several cycles.

Periyot, çakarlar ve karanlıklar dahil b.en: The period is the duration of the whole sequence, flashes and eclipses included.

Q veya VQ, ışığın mutlaka kesintisiz çak.en: Q or VQ does not mean that the light must flash without a break. It can also form a group of a set number of quick flashes, such as Q(3) or VQ(9); cardinal marks use exactly these groups.

Rengi belirle: beyaz mı, kırmızı mı, yeş.en: Identify the color: white, red, green or yellow? Is it confused with background lights ashore?

Sabit bir ışığın üzerine daha parlak çak.en: A steady light with brighter flashes added to it.

Sarı; diğer işaretlerin ritimleriyle kar.en: Yellow; a rhythm that cannot be confused with the other marks

Sarı; tepede sarı X.en: Yellow; a yellow X as topmark

Sector limits are true bearings of the l.en: Sector limits are true bearings of the light seen from seaward. The ship on the left sees the light bearing 090°, inside the white sector 085°–095°. If it drifts south it enters the red sector, if it drifts north the green one. Illustrative values; take the real limits and their meaning from the chart and the List of Lights.

Sektör değişimini kerteriz, radar mesafe.en: Confirm a sector change with a bearing, a radar range or another method of fixing.

Sektör sınırları denizden ışığa doğru al.en: Sector limits are true bearings of the light from seaward.

Sektör sınırları optik olarak keskin değ.en: Sector limits are not optically sharp; do not use the change of color as an exact position line.

Sektör sınırları, aksi belirtilmedikçe,.en: Unless stated otherwise, sector limits are given as true bearings of the light from seaward. If the chart gives the white sector as 085°–095°, a ship that sees the light bearing between 085° and 095° is in the white sector; the ship is west of the light.

Sektör ışığı, farklı doğrultulardan bakı.en: A sector light shows a different color or characteristic depending on the direction from which it is seen. In a common arrangement the white sector marks the safe approach and the red and green sectors mark the limits on either side or the side of a danger. This is a habit, not a rule: you cannot assume that white is always safe or that red or green is always dangerous; read the meaning of the sectors from the chart and the List of Lights.

Siyah, bir veya daha fazla geniş kırmızı.en: Black with one or more broad red horizontal bands; two black spheres as topmark

Standard atmospheric refraction is assum.en: Standard atmospheric refraction is assumed. The result says nothing about fog, rain, background lighting or the intensity of the light; those decide the luminous range.

Tehlike işaretleme: Işık, sığlık, kayalı.en: Marking dangers: a light shows where a shoal, rock or wreck lies, or on which side it can be passed safely.

Tek çakarın süresi en az 2 saniyedir..en: A single flash lasts at least 2 seconds.

The bracket is one period: three flashes.en: The bracket is one period: three flashes and the eclipses between and after them take 10 seconds together. A representative entry, not a real light.

The whole group, flashes and eclipses to.en: The whole group, flashes and eclipses together, repeats every 10 seconds

Yayınları güncel tut: ENC ile birlikte A.en: Keep publications up to date: check the Admiralty List of Lights and Fog Signals, Notices to Mariners and navigational warnings as well as the ENC; a light's characteristic, sectors or operating status can change.

Yeşil, ortasında geniş kırmızı bant.en: Green with one broad red band

Yeşil; Fl(2+1) dışında herhangi bir riti.en: Green; any rhythm other than Fl(2+1)

You are on the leading line..en: You are on the leading line.

You are to port of the line. Alter to st.en: You are to port of the line. Alter to starboard to regain it.

You are to starboard of the line. Alter.en: You are to starboard of the line. Alter to port to regain it.

Çakar sayısını saat kadranıyla eşleştir:.en: Match the number of flashes to a clock face: 3 o'clock is east (3 flashes), 6 o'clock is south (6 flashes and one long flash) and 9 o'clock is west (9 flashes); north flashes without a break. The long flash of the south mark is added so that its group of six cannot be mistaken for a group of three or nine.

Çakarları say: tek mi, ikili ya da üçlü.en: Count the flashes: single, or a group of two or three? Is there a long flash?

Önce iki çakar, sonra ayrı bir tek çakar.en: Two flashes, then a separate single flash.

Özel işaretler ve kullanım mantığı.en: Special marks and how they are used

İki beyaz çakar sayıp grubun 10 saniyede.en: If you count two white flashes and confirm that the group repeats every 10 seconds, the light matches B's characteristic; still confirm it with the bearing and the position.

İki çakar arka arkaya gelir, ardından da.en: Two flashes follow each other, then comes a longer eclipse.

İzole tehlike, emniyetli su ve özel işar.en: Isolated danger, safe water and special marks
